title: Some benchmark labels are simply wrong
body: Audits have estimated several percent of labels in famous test sets are errors or genuinely ambiguous; ImageNet's validation set included mislabeled and multi-object images that punished correct models. Northcutt and colleagues showed rankings can shuffle once labels are cleaned. Leaderboards measure agreement with labels, which is only a proxy for being right.
source_hint: Northcutt, Athalye, Mueller (2021), label errors study
